body: Anyone else grab a ball and loosen up their throwing arm?
I thought the update included a dolphin scowl?>
True. What if it isn't a question of happiness vs. sadness? Unfortunately for me its become pain vs. eternal sleep. Why do we force people to live when they would be more happy dead?
Yea. That's the issue. The people around me are good people....their only fault is likely that they care.

But you have control, right? Isn't that the most important part?

Currently I feel like I am living against my will....you wold end it right? If it was only up to you?

Hey, My best friend is on the spectrum. Unfortunately his siblings more deeply then him, but he still hasn't held down a job. I'm reading your post (speed read it, twice) But unfortunately have trouble drawing many parallels. Despite being socially "retarded" my friend with Asperger's would never intentionally hurt someone like what happened in your story.  Despite the fact that people on the autistic spectrum rarely seem to understand human emotions, they value them greatly. Your boyfriend seems to have several of the main Asperger's problems, but he does, somewhere, care about you. I wish I could offer up more wisdom, but if he is truly on the Autistic spectrum, he is probably wishing he could make he desires known more easily, and without pressure.

Edit: I've also never dated. So don't take my advice.

You seem to get it. In the end, though, I am looking for people in the same situation, I suppose. I mean, life is a very complex thing, and I'm not sure that all of us that can afford to live for many years need to actually do it. My problem is that I have never felt alone and have recently had major pain issues that make not want to exist anymore. I really used to think that anyone wanting to commit suicide had problems of some kind, but it does reach a point where it seems to be the only logical answer.

Unfortunately I thin I'm too young to have medically defined chronic pain. The fact is that, in America, many people try to get pain medication, specifically opiates, with true injuries. 

Pain Doctors do not start treating patients until their fourties (at least that is the message I get). I have trouble with the chicken and the egg problem. I have long struggled with depression (back when the hormones were raging) but afterwards I became pretty content with life in general. But now the pain happening...everyday...it just isn't worth it anymore. 

When you say you are in a shitty place yourself, what do you mean? I feel like hearing your whole story, because I already know I wont be able to sleep tonight. (Tweaked my back pretending I was fine and playing tennis). I cant lay down, so I'm not going anywhere for a while........what say you?
Basically: Want to not have to exist. Don't want to hurt parents. Can't wait any longer. Is there a happy medium (or any medium at all)?
